messages:
julia_cs: Heads-up: MapleAI onboarding reports p99 latency hits in their contract (p99 <= 300ms). We saw p99 ~360ms during bulk dataset upload windows last night. Need triage, credit estimate, and a customer note. @marc_sre @sophia_fin @ravi_legal @zoe_ae

marc_sre: Checking metrics now. My initial read: queue wait + model decode during import bursts. Can you share sample timestamps? I can try a caching + concurrency cap test tonight.

julia_cs: Two samples attached from logs: 22:11 and 22:46 UTC.
```
22:11:07 POST /v1/embeddings p99 362ms host:dedicated-5
- db read 100ms; model decode 230ms; queue 32ms
22:46:33 POST /v1/embeddings p99 358ms host:dedicated-5
- cache miss; db 95ms; model decode 235ms; batching 28ms
```

zoe_ae: FYI they renew in ~9 weeks. Procurement will expect a clear remediation plan; keep credits bounded.

sophia_fin: Contract credit banding options we usually use:
- p99 <= 300ms: 0%
- 300ms < p99 <= 375ms: 3% one-off
- p99 > 375ms: 7% + remediation
I can compute dollars if someone confirms monthly invoice.

ravi_legal: Share the exact SLA clause please. We should avoid language implying platform-wide failure. Use "latency variance observed during onboarding imports" and frame credits as "goodwill per contract terms."

marc_sre: Mitigations: 1) enable short TTL prefix KV cache for import jobs, 2) cap import workers to 5, 3) route interactive traffic to the low-latency model variant. I'll flip 1+2 in staging and run a replay at 23:30 UTC and report results.

julia_cs: Proposed next steps: @marc_sre run the replay and post metrics, @sophia_fin prepare $ amounts for 3% and 7% options, @ravi_legal confirm comms language, I'll draft the customer note for review (aim: 09:30 tomorrow).

sophia_fin: MapleAI monthly commit = $32,500. 3% = $975, 7% = $2,275. I'll note a conditional cap: additional credit only if breach repeats within 30 days.

ravi_legal: Approved tone. If offering conditional extra credit, specify exact trigger (e.g., 2 breaches of p99 > 300ms within 30 days). Avoid words like "outage".

marc_sre: Replay results: with caching + cap, p99 during replay dropped from ~360ms -> ~305ms; batching wait reduced by ~20ms. Will run a second replay for the other window and post by 08:00.

julia_cs: Thanks all. I'll post the draft note after second replay numbers in the morning. Zoe, can you give me a brief on the exec sponsor so I can loop them in?
